name: File identity sentinel
invariants: Zero invalid and every nonzero valid

name: Release and per-build identity
invariants: Release stable; build identity distinguishes binaries

name: SHA-256 file digest
postconditions: Success returns exact bytes hash and size
invariants: Binary read; error cleared on entry
observable_oracle: Independent file digest and exact error class

name: Lowercase SHA-256 text
postconditions: Two lowercase hex chars per byte

name: Isolated artifact staging
invariants: Unique root; destructor cleans best effort; object not copyable
errors: Path/staging creation failure; copy is compile-time error
observable_oracle: Stage layout, cleanup and compile-time ownership

name: Whole-set artifact preflight
postconditions: No final destination changed before all prepared
invariants: Every stage regular and destination replaceable

name: Ordered multi-artifact commit
postconditions: All entries installed; backups removed; committed true
observable_oracle: Exact final bytes and no residues

name: Reverse artifact rollback
inputs: Partially installed set and original error
postconditions: Installed outputs removed and backups restored best effort
invariants: Reverse order; preserve original commit error

name: Artifact stage seeding
postconditions: Missing source is successful cold path; present source copied
